picks.editorial_note: A Fermilab-led team's selection under DOE's new Genesis Mission to fix particle-accelerator instabilities with AI signals a major federal bet on AI-driven scientific infrastructure, with ripple effects across the national lab system.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A Google-led, government-backed North Atlantic trial using AI to reroute flights around contrail formation is a real-world test of AI climate mitigation at commercial-aviation scale — a rare case of AI research moving straight into operational deployment.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute pairing AI with high-throughput automated experiments to hunt for new battery materials shows how academia-industry AI partnerships are accelerating materials discovery timelines that once took years.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9M NSF-funded iDLab, unifying browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advances the NAIRR pilot's goal of democratizing AI compute access for researchers nationwide.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: MIT's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs from massive datasets often can't be traced to any training example — has significant implications for copyright disputes and AI transparency debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: Study finds generated images often can’t be traced to training data

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's joint lab targeting next-generation data storage for AI workloads addresses a critical infrastructure bottleneck as AI data demands continue to outpace hardware capacity.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College's five-year partnership with Smith+Nephew to translate computer-vision research into surgical robotics is a concrete example of AI research reaching operating rooms.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: Old Dominion's NASA-funded AI digital twin proved itself during actual Norfolk flooding rather than in a lab, offering rare validation of AI coastal-resilience tools under live disaster conditions.
picks.title: When Norfolk Flooded, ODU Coastal Defense Research Faced an Unexpected Real-World Test

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in over $42 million of NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants underscores sustained federal investment in the national-scale cyberinfrastructure that underpins AI research at scale.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic AI system moving into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations marks a notable step of academic AI research into operational defense systems.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE
